problem: Small merchants lack data and data science to run Amazon style recommendations; Suggestr used multimodal AI on product images to power upsells and bundles with little data.
business_model: SaaS app subscription for Shopify merchants

founders.name: Aditya Mehta
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built and sold recommender systems to banks.

founders.name: Oleksii Sidorov
prior_employers: University of Oxford Experimental Psychology lab
founders.background_notes: YC page lists two exits and 15 ML papers.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multimodal embeddings for recommendations with low data, plus a Shopify app.

defensibility.rationale: Incumbent apps already existed and Shopify app distribution was open to all.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were already established; Suggestr's Shopify app was later delisted.

market_need_then: The pitch cites Amazon driving up to 30 percent of sales from personalization; no independent dated source collected.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive coinage but no brand press.

outcome_analysis: Suggestr raised a 500K note in April 2022 and its Shopify app is no longer listed, with YC marking it Inactive. Established recommendation vendors such as Rebuy, Nosto and LimeSpot existed, but no post-mortem states the cause, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: Website field blank in the directory; the Shopify app page says not currently available. Round rests on CB Insights (convertible note, with Entrepreneurs First); VCBacked calls it pre-seed in March 2022. Competitors Rebuy, Nosto and LimeSpot come from undated listings so are not recorded. Cause not public; the competition_won factor is an inference. A CB Insights acquired label likely belongs to LimeSpot.
